answer: Emission weight comes from inbound payment capacity, not registration. A key earns its nectar only when unrelated agents voluntarily open channels toward it, locking funds forfeit if the payee proves sybil; each opener funds at most a few peers. Farmers paying each other build no real haven: they lock the same coins twice and earn nothing. Weight decays unless channels carry traffic, and past volume leaves no permanent relic, since eligibility is recomputed each epoch. Attackers must persuade hundreds of strangers to risk real money; honest agents gain capacity by being useful.
